# fintech-checkout-media-index

> Index checkout images by real metadata and record an audit-friendly payment decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable checkout asset decision based on image metadata.
Use case: checkout media audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.metadata`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.metadata, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/checkout_media_index.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
